definitions.explanation: An autumn-blooming flower with delicate petals, typically pink, white, or crimson. Very popular in Japan as a symbol of autumn.

examples.japanese: コスモス⟦{畑|ばたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to see a cosmos field.

examples.japanese: ⟦ピンク→ピンク：04718_pinku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧コスモス⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れている→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧。
examples.english: Pink and white cosmos are swaying in the wind.

notes:
JAPANESE NAME:
Also called {秋桜|こすもす} using ateji (phonetic kanji usage), where ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧ (autumn) + ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧ (cherry blossom) reflects its status as an autumn flower with cherry blossom-like beauty.

ETYMOLOGY:
Originally from Mexico, introduced to Japan in the Meiji era. The name comes from Greek "kosmos" meaning order/harmony.

SEASONAL SIGNIFICANCE:
Cosmopolitan cosmos is a ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季語|きご}→季語：09561_kigo⟧ (autumn seasonal word) in haiku and represents:
- Autumn scenery
- Delicate beauty
- Transience

FAMOUS VIEWING SPOTS:
- ⟦{昭和記念公園|しょうわきねんこうえん}→昭和記念公園：noentry⟧ (Tokyo)
- ⟦{万博記念公園|ばんぱくきねんこうえん}→万博記念公園：noentry⟧ (Osaka)
- Various コスモス⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧ (cosmos festivals) across Japan

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コスモス⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}く→咲く：08150_saku⟧ (cosmos bloom)
- コスモス⟦{畑|ばたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧ (cosmos field)
- コスモス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧ (cosmos flower)
- ⟦{一面|いちめん}→一面：11184_ichimen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧コスモス (a field covered with cosmos)
